newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Iwai's Int'l denies takeover rumours.
newsitem.headline: Iwai's Int'l denies takeover rumours.

text.p: Iwai's International Holdings Ltd said on Thursday that its substantial shareholders were not in talks to sell their stakes, denying rumours that the company may be subject to takeover bids by outside parties.

Chairman Masuru Iwai said "presently neither the directors nor substantial shareholders of the company are in discussion with any parties which may lead to any disposal of shares of the company or an offer for the securities of the company."
Shares of the apparel retailer, which had risen HK$0.26 or 30.59 percent in the past three trading days, fell HK$0.10 or 9.01 percent to HK$1.01 at midday on Thursday.
